items.title: Kohl’s Deploys AI Assistant, On-Demand Delivery, Flexible Payments for Holidays
items.why: Identify Kohl's flexible payment provider; a BNPL partner there could inform our installment feature talks.
items.summary_ai: Kohl's CEO said on its Q3 call that it launched an AI shopping assistant and expanded on-demand delivery and flexible payment options for the holidays.
items.take: Identify Kohl's flexible payment provider; a BNPL partner there could inform our installment feature talks.

items.title: Kohl’s turns a corner in Q3, no thanks to Sephora
items.why: Kohl's posted positive comparable sales in most categories in its third quarter, driven by private label and store upgrades, with profits rising sharply.
